business_problem: Armani Beach Residences at Palm Jumeirah, Aljada, and Masaar—these are just some of the premium living spaces by Arada, a trendsetter in the UAE's real estate sector. Arada needed to bring its various departments together onto a single platform, enabling collaboration and efficiency. By choosing Microsoft Azure, Dynamics 365 Fin Ops, and Microsoft 365 E5, Arada enabled the seamless integration of its back and front office functions. By making customer and internal information and insights easily accessible, it has empowered its team to serve customers faster and make informed decisions. Using the cloud platform has also led to lowered infrastructure and maintenance costs.
solution_summary: Arada used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Microsoft Dynamics 365 to standardize sales execution and customer follow-up.
